prompt: A population has 4 individuals with fitness [0.2, 0.5, 0.8, 0.3]. Which is selected by tournament (k=2) when the randomly chosen pair is individual 1 (0.2) and individual 3 (0.8)?
code: // Tournament size k=2: compare two random individuals
explanation: Tournament selection picks the better individual from the randomly chosen pair. Individual 3 with fitness 0.8 beats individual 1 with fitness 0.2.
